fit_reason: Whole 2010 Ford F-150 pickup listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Red paint on the doors and bed sides looks somewhat flat with light haze rather than a deep gloss
Rear tailgate and bed side paint appears dull and slightly faded
Rubber floor mats on the driver side look dusty and scuffed with dirt
Dash, gauge cluster area and console look dusty
Black leather seats look dry and a bit dull, with wear on the driver bolster
Black plastic rear bumper top and step areas look faded and grayed
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2010 F-150 Lariat. The red paint on the sides and tailgate looks a little flat in the photos, and the floor mats and dash could use a cleaning. We do pre-sale details and paint buffing and come to you, which would help it show better to buyers. Would you like a quote?
